name: full_page_writes
description: When enabled, writes full disk pages to WAL on first modification after a checkpoint to enable safe crash recovery.
symptoms: Higher I/O pressure during peak write loads
Data corruption risk after unclean shutdown if disabled
Recovery failure due to incomplete page state

constraints.hard_rule: value == true if wal_level >= 'replica' and fsync == true

tuning_tips: Keep enabled in production for data safety; only disable temporarily for bulk load performance testing on isolated, non-critical systems with guaranteed clean shutdowns.
